purpose: Blueprint for the private/vendor-only GitHub App used to access the ANPOS private commercial template. This App is not the Marketplace listing App and this file contains no credentials.
security_requirements: This App must be distinct from the public/customer-facing Marketplace GitHub App.
Generate its private key only in GitHub and store it in an approved secret manager; never commit it.
Install it only on the vendor-controlled private commercial-template repository.
Use archive-first delivery with Contents: read as the default mode.
Do not enable Administration: write unless collaborator provisioning is explicitly enabled.
Do not subscribe this vendor-only App to Marketplace purchase events.
Store final App/installation/repository identifiers only in deployed vendor runtime configuration.
